description: A committed, permanent local example of the ai-3d-factory multi-part assembly workflow: a classroom sign with a base plate, a separately-colored raised room-number text layer, and a small accent badge/icon, all sharing one origin per docs/slicer-review-workflow.md. Hand-authored in OpenSCAD (no built-in generate-openscad template covers a 3-part sign with a badge accent yet - only the 2-part multipart-nameplate template exists). This is a demo/reference project living under examples/, meant as a baseline pattern future richer multi-part models (cars, animals, people, manufacturing demos) can build on - see examples/multipart-classroom-sign/README.md.
constraints: Original design only - no franchise/copyrighted logos or characters (see docs/licensing-policy.md).
Demo scale only (150mm x 50mm base plate) - not sized against any real classroom door or sign holder.
This is a workflow example, not a print order: no STL has been exported, and this example is not slicer_review_ready, human_approved, or print_ready.
